text: Stumbled upon this amazing clinic at Jungceylon shopping mall. You can make a reservation through their number on WhatsApp, but they also do walk ins. I went with their “wink” IV drip,(Vitamin C, ALA, gluta)because my dull skin was in need of it!! It’s also exceptionally cheaper here than in the US. They offer a variety of beauty and health services at reasonable prices~

Beware of scam! Nice service with decent IV offerings however NAD isn’t strong and same price as the states. I finished it in less than 30 mins with no discomfort which is very unusual for NAD so I don’t believe this is actually what I received. I think this is likely diluted solutions or just saline because they aren’t very transparent with ingredients and strength and refused to show me the ingredients because the sales consultant couldn’t go “behind the counter”. Gentle technician but way over priced for the poor quality. Had to go elsewhere for proper follow up care and refused to acknowledge my concerns due to “language barrier”.

I went in today looking for some advice on what would be suitable for my face. I was taken care of the moment I walked in and they even done a tailored procedure suitable for my face. The results I can see straight away, and it will only get better as time passes. Thank you to the team for all their amazing efforts, from the staff to the doctor. Thank you so much. I never expected to be taken care of this much.

The worst waxing ever! Their prices are ridiculously high, and they know nothing about waxing techniques. They pull the paper upwards painfully, and their excuse is, "My skin is thin" I've been getting this done for 15 years, and this has never happened to me before. The bed doesn't work and moves downwards every minute. I got blue spots on my skin, and I have an event tomorrow. There are so many spots where the hair wasn't removed. I had to stop and not complete the service. If your service is bad and you see it with your own eyes, you shouldn't make excuses. The customer is always right.

I booked for laser hair removal, when I arrived they said they forgot to tell me the machine was broken, very unprofessional but I did receive a refund. I then had Botox which I was told would last 3-4 months , it’s lasted 6 weeks! I have contacted the team and they said this “sometimes happens”. I am very unhappy as this has never happened before and I know it is down to poor technique or poor quality Botox. Do not come here for Botox .
